body.x: NAL(North American Lighting) introduced digital Adaptive Driving Beam LED Headlights for the drivers at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' held in Las Vegas on January 7th (Sunday).

North American Lighting (NAL) has provided automotive lighting systems for vehicle manufacturers in U.S., Canada, and Mexico. It produces a full range of products including forward lighting, signal lighting, rear combination lighting, accessory lighting, and all-digital Adaptive Driving Beam lighting systems.

NAL has developed next-generation ADB (adaptive driving beam) technology that will see, sense, adapt and react to rapidly changing driving conditions. It automatically adjusts the light according to the driving information scanning the road ahead using the integrated camera and sensor beyond the traditional manually-controlled system.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
